paragraph: Franklin Lakes is a single-family market with 63 sales over six months at a median of $1,860,000, and the sale-to-list ratio came in at exactly 1.00 with 41 percent of homes closing above asking. Median days on market was 17, so well-priced homes are moving quickly, but the ratio tells you buyers are not routinely bidding past list. Call it competitive without being frenzied. The price range runs from $580,000 to $4,850,000, which is wide enough that the median is the number to anchor on rather than the average. Volume built the way it should heading into summer, from 7 closings in May to 12 in June and 19 in July. The July median of $1,900,000 sits below June's $2,225,000, but that came on far more sales, which reads as a shift in what sold rather than a drop in value. If the usual seasonal pattern holds, expect closings to thin out through fall. Condo and townhouse activity is minimal here, 4 sales in six months, too few to draw a trend from. If you want anything other than a detached house in Franklin Lakes, inventory is the constraint, not price.
